title: Execute one transported CRT repair key on binary tapes
body:
PR4716 leaves its three current-state CRT queries as host arithmetic. This package implements one complete transported `T(S^-1(q))` key on five fixed binary tape roles: fresh descriptor copies at all three epochs, bitwise cached CRT arithmetic, a complete 544-bit ROM scan per query, full 15-bit modular carry/borrow, and scratch/head restoration. The physical 18-bit input/output includes and preserves the back spectator.

The two existing stale-offset witnesses now execute with **171,252** and **171,266 tape actions**. These count actual reads, writes and one-cell moves; they exclude Boolean control time, setup, inverse/ROM compilation and observer work. This is a fixed reduced `H=G=1,K=5` implementation, **not a uniform `E(p,ell)` bit-step tariff**, complete repair/caller, supplier admission or new κ.

Validation on macOS arm64 / Python 3.12.2:

- Registered metadata/source pins and normal replay pass; direct optimized replay also passes.
- 24 deterministic keys agree with the exact retained caller at all three query epochs. A separate interpreter reconstructs every tape from the unit event stream, checking borrowed input/ROM preservation, zero private scratch/work and all head returns.
- Nine rejecting controls cover the second/third stale offset, truncated high carry, clearing/head omissions, wrong CRT weight, invalid-left enabling, transported-descriptor error and a missing unit-move event.
- A separate Codex agent reviewed the data/control accounting and independently replayed 12 keys, checking 2,048,028 unit events. This is AI review, not human or formal acceptance.
- Committed-byte/source-history checks pass for all 12 package/input files. Export integrity and Git-free optimized replay pass; live-source, retained-caller and frozen-receipt corruption reject, and all 13 export files are restored byte-for-byte.

Only `research/crt-transported-key-tape/` is added. PR4716's caller is retained unchanged with exact origin/hash/credit; the live modules are pinned to canonical main `b58ad9ef4d4e861b0eaa5dba41742bdc072dca51`. Open next questions explicitly separate uniform counter/ROM production costs from the scanner-mask/repair interface join. No selected cold replay, Lean, Docker or full repair was run.

[Canonical investigation and claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4709#discussioncomment-19130274).

Credit Cinna Davis/#4100, Hiroki KUMAZAKI/#4169/#4174/#4716, Ryanson Jonathan/#4328/#4409, unpaidmoon/#4377/#4644/#4650, ToikY/#4192/#4201/#4208, codyw912/#4637, and the retained Jose Manuel/John-Michael Smith/Douglas Colkitt physical-repair and compact-control lineage. Prepared by JoyboyBrian with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance and separate agent review; Apache-2.0.

Pre-submission refresh: canonical main remains `b58ad9ef4d4e861b0eaa5dba41742bdc072dca51` (priority revision 7). The shared snapshot covers 499 open PR bodies at 18:35 UTC and 3,648 Discussion records at 18:36 UTC, with complete reported pagination; the scoped search also covers all 5,862 tracked notes at this publication commit. PR4716 was checked live and remains at `d9913fe24f119f9d431f324dbbe7d90de409a856`. No newly overlapping implementation was found beyond the credited predecessor/repair interface and this claim; code diffs, closed-only artifacts and unpublished work remain outside that search.
